Notice Of Motion For Default Prove Up Hearing
Off Calendar Feb-14-2013 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald Sullivan, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, CSR: Sonia Wong, #11288.

Elizabeth MacDonald, Esq., appearing for Plaintiff, State Farm Mutual Automobile Ins. Co.
Order Granting waiver of Witness Requirement of Hearing on Application for Default Prove-up, on file.
No appearance by defaulted defendant(s) Dominique L. Dominguez.
Default of Defendant(s) has been duly entered.
Defendants Salvador C. Garcia and Does 1-10 Dismissed without prejudice on 9/18/2012.

After Evidence and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff and against Defaulted Defendant(s) as follows:

Damages: $35,000.00
Pre-Judgment Interest: $3,462.36
Costs: $520.00
Total Judgment in the amount of $38,982.36
Other (specify): Pursuant to CVC 17151 and 1715, the judgment against DOMINIQUE L. DOMINGUEZ is enforceable only to the extent of the minimum insurance requirements at the time the accident which were $5,000.00 for property and $15,000.00 per person to a maximum of $30,000.00 for personal inuries. In this case $35,000.00 plus cost in the amount of $520.00 plus interest in the amount of $3,462. 36 is the amount enforceble against DOMINIQUE L. DOMINGUEZ.

Judgment signed in open court.
